ports.original_data: Use your complete original Medal of Honor: Allied Assault base data. Upstream recommends Warchest. For CD versions follow the upstream patch sequence (Allied Assault 1.11, Spearhead 2.11 then 2.15, Breakthrough 2.40b) as applicable. Keep the matching main resources, including Pak*.pk3, sound and video. Expansion files do not replace base data; console editions are different products.
ports.preparation: Use a private working copy of the original game folder. Extract the complete official openmohaa-v0.82.1-windows-x64.zip into it, preserving DLLs and companions. Follow upstream Visual C++ x64 runtime prerequisites when needed. Register launch_openmohaa_base.exe with the game root as working directory. This title-specific launcher selects Allied Assault and waits for openmohaa.exe to exit. Do not select omohaaded.exe, PDB archives or another expansion launcher.
ports.persistent_data: Preserve the complete working game copy and actual fs_homepath, normally beneath the Windows roaming application-data directory. An explicit fs_homepath can redirect all user storage, including into the game directory; preserve that actual location rather than assuming one profile folder for all configurations. Original saves/mods and engine-version compatibility remain upstream responsibilities.
ports.remaining: Managed fitting requires a supported original-data preparation/completion contract and maintenance evidence; no managed definition or native gameplay acceptance is added.

ports.original_data: Use original classic Doom 3 base PK4 data. BFG Edition is a different product. Keep the complete matching original-data installation unchanged and use a private working copy or the explicit upstream data-root option.
ports.preparation: Keep the complete dude-0.9.6-win64.zip and its DLL/resources together. Register dude.exe in its runtime folder. Point to the folder containing base with three separate argument lines: +set, fs_basepath, then the absolute data-root path. Optional baked-AO downloads are separate from the player. Renderer and hardware requirements differ by mode; this fork does not inherit dhewm3 qualification.
ports.persistent_data: Windows normally stores saves and settings under the actual Documents/My Games/dude profile, with base/d3xp scopes. Explicit fs_savepath or mod paths can redirect writes. Preserve the actual profile, originals and creating runtime. Linux uses its own upstream location; no cross-engine or mod save compatibility is inferred. Before first Play, preserve both the existing Documents/My Games/dhewm3 profile and its creating runtime as well as any dude profile. If the dude profile is missing, this upstream Windows build silently copies the existing dhewm3 tree into it. A private original/runtime copy does not isolate that profile behavior. This is an upstream copy, not a move, Core adoption or proof of save compatibility; decide whether to continue with that behavior before Play.
ports.remaining: Managed fitting requires a supported original-data preparation/completion contract and maintenance evidence; no managed definition or native gameplay acceptance is added.

ports.original_data: Both Zeus: Master of Olympus and the Poseidon expansion original files are required, including for the base-game identity. Upstream currently supports English and Polish. Preserve the original installation and work in a separate complete copy; eZeus differs from the original and does not promise exact parity.
ports.preparation: Prepare the full eZeus-0.8.2-beta.zip from its base release, then the later eZeus-0.8.2-beta.4.exe patch. The patch EXE alone is not a complete package. Follow the base release instructions: extract the eZeus folder under your working Zeus and Poseidon folder, perform upstream text conversion of Zeus_Text.eng and Zeus_MM.eng to the corresponding XML files, and place them where upstream specifies. Apply the patch player in the eZeus Bin folder, retaining all base resources. Register Bin/eZeus-0.8.2-beta.4.exe with Bin as working directory. engconverter-0.5.exe and VC_redist.x64.exe are preparation helpers, not players; run prerequisites deliberately only when needed.
ports.persistent_data: The player normally finds originals two directories above its EXE, or through zeus_path.txt. The eZeus root above Bin owns settings.txt, Save and companion resources such as Textures/Adventures. Preserve the entire working originals and eZeus tree, including any explicit original path, before replacing upstream files. No old-save conversion or base/expansion compatibility is inferred.
ports.remaining: The latest release supplies a patch player, not a standalone game. Complete upstream preparation is required; managed setup and native gameplay remain unqualified.
